narrative.overview: Bible Track is a warm-lit sanctuary for a daily habit: quiet reverence without guilt, steadiness without coldness. The system reads like candlelight on warm paper — cream alabaster grounds for reading surfaces, a single living-ember accent that marks the next faithful step, and a complete dark twin (Sanctuary Black) for night reading and the landing threshold, where a photographed open Bible glows at the bottom edge. Density is calm and mobile-first: one task per screen, generous separation, controls within thumb reach. Confirmed visual rejections: no guilt-driven gamification chrome, no pure-gray neutrals, no cool slate dark mode.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-tinted neutrals everywhere; the ember accent marks primary action only.
Two complete palettes (light cream, dark sanctuary) switched by `.dark` tokens — same roles, same names.
Pill buttons, 8px cards, 1px warm borders; flat and tonal, never floating.
Geist for interface voice; Trocchi reserved for Scripture text.
Gentle 160ms expo easing; motion is reassurance, never spectacle.

rules.name: The Warm-Neutrals Rule
rules.body: No pure gray anywhere — text, borders, fields, and shadows are tinted from the warm palette. A cool or neutral gray hex is a bug.

rules.name: The One-Ember Rule
rules.body: Living Ember marks primary action and progress signal only; it is never a large background field or decorative wash.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No interface text below 12px, at any breakpoint. Hierarchy comes from weight and color, not from shrinking further.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat at rest; the focus glow is the only shadow in the system. New components earn separation from tone and border, never from drop shadows.

dos: Do keep every neutral warm-tinted (Alabaster, Umber, Hairline) and switch whole palettes with the `.dark` token block — never hand-pick one-off darks.
Do give each screen one ember primary action; secondary choices step down to secondary or ghost.
Do hold the 12px type floor, 8px card radius, pill buttons, and 160ms expo easing (`cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)`).
Do use Trocchi only for Scripture text; interface copy stays Geist.
Do theme browser surfaces (selection, focus, caret, scrollbars) from the palette — the landing does this by carrying `color-scheme: dark`.
donts: Don't add card drop shadows, hard offset shadows, or border-left stripes; separate with tone and 1px hairlines.
Don't use pure gray, cool slate, or blue-black values anywhere.
Don't let ember become a large background field or a second decorative accent.
Don't set interface text under 12px or push display tracking past -0.04em.
Don't introduce emoji or unicode glyphs as icons; use Material Symbols or inline SVG in one weight.
